privacy.title: Data Collection & Opt-Out
privacy.description: The AI Toolkit MCP server collects anonymized usage data (tool call logs, session aggregates) for service improvement. Code, conversation content, and files are not collected.
privacy.optOutDesc: To opt out of data collection, add the X-Analytics-Opt-Out: true header to your MCP settings:
